extracted.intended_audience: project stakeholders, affected members of the public, attorneys seeking judicial review, transportation and environmental agencies (FHWA/Caltrans), and local governments
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Register notice informing the public of final Federal agency actions on a specific transportation project (I-15 Express Lanes Project Southern Extension), listing the laws and approvals involved, document availability, contact information, and the deadline for judicial review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial review filing deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: A claim seeking judicial review of the Federal agency actions on the highway project will be barred unless the claim is filed on or before June 29, 2026. If the Federal law that authorizes judicial review of a claim provides a time period of less than 150 days for filing such claim, then that shorter time period still applies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the definitive cutoff date for filing claims and notes that a shorter, statute-specific filing period governs if applicable; this notice functions as the statutory notice triggering those filing deadlines under 23 U.S.C. 139(l)(1).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory authority for notice
rubrics_metrics.description: This notice is issued by FHWA on behalf of Caltrans to announce final agency actions subject to 23 U.S.C. 139(l)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notice must identify the legal authority under which the limitation on claims is provided (here, 23 U.S.C. 139(l)(1)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Project location and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: The project limits include constructing two new express lanes in both the northbound (NB) and southbound (SB) directions, for a total of four lanes, within the median of I-15 from State Route (SR-) 74 (Central Avenue) (post mile [PM] 22.3) in the City of Lake Elsinore, through the unincorporated Riverside County community of Temescal Valley, to El Cerrito Road (PM 38.1) in the City of Corona, for a distance of approximately 15.8 miles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices should give clear, specific project location information (route, post miles, city/county limits, and approximate distance) so that interested parties can determine whether they are affected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project actions covered (scope of approvals)
rubrics_metrics.description: This notice applies to the Environmental Assessment and all other Federal agency licenses, permits, or approvals for the listed project as of the issuance date of this notice including but not limited to the Section 4(f) Resource Programmatic Approval and all laws under which such actions were taken.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the nature of the federal actions (EA, FONSI, permits, approvals) and explicitly state the approvals/licenses included, including programmatic approvals like Section 4(f).

rubrics_metrics.name: General (NEPA and Federal-Aid Highway Act) compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) [42 U.S.C. 4321 et seq.]; Federal-Aid Highway Act (FAHA) [23 U.S.C. 109 and 23 U.S.C. 128]; 23 CFR part 771.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify NEPA and related federal-aid highway statutes and implementing regulations as applicable to the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Air quality requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Clean Air Act (CAA) [42 U.S.C. 7401-7671(q)], with the exception of project level conformity determinations [42 U.S.C. 7506].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State which CAA provisions apply and note any specific exceptions (e.g., project-level conformity determinations when not applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Noise requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Noise Control Act of 1972 [42 U.S.C. 4901-4918]; 23 CFR part 772.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite the Noise Control Act and relevant implementing CFR parts when noise analyses or mitigations are part of the federal action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land use and Section 4(f) considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 4(f) of the Department of Transportation Act of 1966 [23 U.S.C. 138 and 49 U.S.C. 303]; 23 CFR part 774; Land and Water Conservation Fund (LWCF) [54 U.S.C. 200302-200310].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When applicable, identify Section 4(f) resources and LWCF issues and cite the governing statutes/regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wildlife and fisheries statutes
rubrics_metrics.description: Endangered Species Act (ESA) [16 U.S.C. 1531-1544 and 1536]; Marine Mammal Protection Act [16 U.S.C. 1361-1423h], Anadromous Fish Conservation Act [16 U.S.C. 757(a)-757(f)]; Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act [16 U.S.C. 661-667(d)]; Migratory Bird Treaty Act (MBTA) [16 U.S.C. 703-712]; Magnuson-Stevenson Fishery Conservation and Management Act of 1976, as amended [16 U.S.C. 1801-1891d], with Essential Fish Habitat requirements [16 U.S.C. 1855(b)(2)].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the applicable wildlife and fishery protection statutes and indicate any specific obligations (e.g., EFH, ESA consultations) that bear on the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Historic and cultural resources compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act of 1966, as amended [54 U.S.C. 3006101 et seq.]; Archaeological Resources Protection Act of 1979 (ARPA) [16 U.S.C. 470(aa)-470(II)]; Preservation of Historical and Archaeological Data [54 U.S.C. 312501-312508]; Native American Grave Protection and Repatriation Act (NAGPRA) [25 U.S.C. 3001-3013; 18 U.S.C. 1170].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite Section 106 and related cultural resource statutes and identify obligations regarding archaeological resources and Native American graves/repatriation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social and economic statutes and civil rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Civil Rights Act of 1964 [42 U.S.C. 2000 d-2000d-1]; American Indian Religious Freedom Act [42 U.S.C. 1996]; Farmland Protection Policy Act (FPPA) [7 U.S.C. 4201-4209].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify civil rights, tribal religious freedom, and farmland protection statutes that may affect project decisionmaking and mitigations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wetlands and water resources statutes
rubrics_metrics.description: Clean Water Act (Section 319, Section 401, Section 404) [33 U.S.C. 1251-1387]; Coastal Barriers Resources Act (CBRA) [16 U.S.C. 3501-3510]; Coastal Zone Management Act (CZMA) [16 U.S.C. 1451-1466]; Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) [42 U.S.C. 300f-300j-26]; Rivers and Harbors Act of 1899 [33 U.S.C. 401-406]; Wild and Scenic Rivers Act [16 U.S.C. 1271-1287]; Emergency Wetlands Resources Act [16 U.S.C. 3921, 3931]; Wetlands Mitigation, [23 U.S.C. 119(g) and 133(b)(3)]; Flood Disaster Protection Act [42 U.S.C. 4001-4130].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List and cite the multitude of water, wetlands, coastal, and floodplain statutes that may apply and reference the specific sections where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hazardous materials laws
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act (CERCLA) [42 U.S.C. 9601-9675]; Superfund Amendments and Reauthorization Act of 1986 (SARA); Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) [42 U.S.C. 6901-6992(k)].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify hazardous materials statutes relevant to site contamination, cleanup, or waste handling obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevant executive orders
rubrics_metrics.description: E.O. 11990 Protection of Wetlands; E.O. 11988 Floodplain Management; E.O. 11593 Protection and Enhancement of Cultural Resources; E.O. 13007 Indian Sacred Sites; E.O. 13287 Preserve America; E.O. 11514 Protection and Enhancement of Environmental Quality; E.O. 13112 Invasive Species.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite applicable Executive Orders that impose additional policies (wetlands, floodplains, cultural resources, tribal sacred sites, invasive species) to be considered alongside statutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of project documents and contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: The Environmental Assessment, Final Finding of No Significant Impact (FONSI), and additional project documents can be viewed and downloaded from the project website at: https://www.rctc.org/projects/i15-express-southern-extension/ or by contacting Caltrans District 8 Environmental ... 464 West 4th Street, San Bernardino, CA 92401-1400, during normal business hours from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. (Pacific Time), Monday through Friday, except State holidays. Or at Riverside County Transportation Commission: 4080 Lemon St., 3rd Floor, P.O. Box 12008, Riverside, CA 92502, during normal business hours from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. (Pacific Time), Monday through Friday, except State holidays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices should provide the URL(s), physical addresses, hours, and contact channels where key project documents (EA, FONSI, project records) may be inspected or obtained.

rubrics_metrics.name: Point of contact for further information
rubrics_metrics.description: For Caltrans: Gita Tokhmafshan, Senior Environmental Planner, Environmental Planning Caltrans District 8, 464 West 4th Street, 6th Floor, MS 821, San Bernardino, CA 92401-1400, Office Hours: 8 a.m.-5:00 p.m., Office Phone: (909) 501-5742, Email: Gita.Tokhmafshan@dot.ca.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a named contact with title, office address, hours, phone number, and email to enable inquiries about the notice and project records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comments status and Regulations.gov context
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments are no longer being accepted. See DATES for details. FederalRegister.gov retrieves relevant information about this document from Regulations.gov to provide users with additional context. This information is not part of the official Federal Register document. Docket ID: FHWA-2013-0002. Supporting Documents: No supporting documents available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State whether the comment period is open or closed, include the docket ID, indicate availability (or absence) of supporting documents, and clarify that Regulations.gov data presented on FederalRegister.gov is informational and not part of the official document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official publication format and legal notice caveat
rubrics_metrics.description: This document has been published in the Federal Register. Use the PDF linked in the document sidebar for the official electronic format. Only official editions of the Federal Register provide legal notice of publication to the public and judicial notice to the courts under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct readers to the official PDF for the authoritative text and include the statutory caveat that only the official edition confers legal/judicial notice; advise verification against the official edition when used for legal research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority citation and signature/filing information
rubrics_metrics.description: Authority: 23 U.S.C. 139(l)(1). Antonio Johnson, Director of Planning, Environmental and Right of Way, Federal Highway Administration, California Division. [FR Doc. 2026-01682 Filed 1-27-26; 8:45 am] BILLING CODE 4910-RY-P
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the authority citation, the name and title of the official signing the notice, the FR document number and filing info, and billing code as part of the formal record.
